- Ships real products, alone or with teams: three products currently live in production (see below), all built and launched by him.

- Track record with numbers: ×5 ARR growth in three quarters (Erasoft.io), 300K+ MAU platform, 3× conversion uplift and a +$1M ARR deal (Improvado.io), 70% 3-month retention on a self-founded product.

- Leadership style: direct truth over politeness, trust and guidance over micro-management, calculated risk over safe stagnation.

## Products in production

- [NicePass](https://nicepass.cc): Loyalty-card platform for restaurants — Apple/Google Wallet passes, AI-driven campaigns, iiko integration. Replaces expensive SMS marketing.
- [Stopwell](https://stopwell.app): Flight concierge that plans the trip around arriving in shape for the event, not just price or duration.
- [VPNKill](https://vpnkill.com): macOS menu-bar kill switch that blocks any traffic not routed through the VPN.

- 2025–now (since April 2025): CPO — Vestora. Disrupting business real estate with AI and complex data models.
- 2023–now: COO/PM — Erasoft.io. HR-tech platform for retail, 300K+ MAU; ×5 ARR in Q1–Q3 2023.
- 2022: Senior Project Manager — Improvado.io. Marketing analytics automation; 3× conversion uplift, helped close a +$1M ARR deal.
- 2020–2022: Founder — LTVCAC.agency. Performance marketing and JTBD-based market research.
- 2017–2019: Co-founder — Togezzer.net. Internal comms for distributed teams; 60 alpha companies, 70% 3-month retention.
- 2015–2017: Co-founder — Knedlik Tech. Travel services mobile app, delivered in 4 months.
- 2013–2015: PM/Tech Lead — Globus-ltd.com. Led a portfolio generating 70% of company revenue.
